g.text: Mapping the estuarine habitats of NSW
This dashboard compares the extent of mapped estuarine
habitats in NSW over time since the 1980s.
The habitats mapped include seagrasses, mangroves and
saltmarshes. Other features including foreshore type and
disturbances to habitats have been mapped in selected
Mapping methods have changed considerably over time,
leading to increases in accuracy and detail. Consequently,
some of the earliest maps may over- or under-represent
habitat extent. Changes relatively to 1980 are indicative only
and comparisons of time periods after 2000 are considered
The extent of some seagrass species changes over short time
periods meaning the most recent maps may not represent the
current extent of all species in an estuary
This dashboard is for internal use only.
It contains unreleased data and must not be shared externally.
